items.headline: U.S. Equities Close Higher Amid Mixed Sentiment, Treasury Yields Recede
items.summary: U.S. equity markets concluded Thursday's session with modest gains across major indices, despite an early downturn fueled by disappointing retail earnings and rising Treasury yields. A late-day recovery propelled stocks higher, as investors continued to digest Federal Reserve minutes and awaited further economic data.

items.headline: Moderna Soars on Vaccine Trial Success
items.summary: Moderna ($MRNA) shares surged by a remarkable 177.0% today after a late-stage study of its experimental mRNA-based vaccine met its primary goal of extending the time before high-risk melanoma returns in patients.

items.headline: Deere & Co. Rises on Strong Earnings and AI Boost
items.summary: Deere & Company ($DE) saw its stock climb over 3% after reporting its first quarterly profit in three years and raising its full-year forecast, citing tariff refunds and an AI construction boom as key drivers.

items.headline: Walmart Shares Dip on Sales Miss, Cautious Outlook
items.summary: Walmart Inc. ($WMT) shares fell nearly 6% today following its second-quarter earnings report, which showed it missed expectations for comparable sales growth and issued disappointing forward guidance.

items.headline: Advance Auto Parts Falls After Disappointing Q2 Sales
items.summary: Advance Auto Parts Inc. ($AAP) experienced a significant decline of 19.67% after its second-quarter results revealed a 0.5% decrease in comparable store sales, primarily impacted by weaker spending in the DIY channel.

items.headline: Health Care, Consumer Discretionary Lead Sector Gains
items.summary: Among S&P 500 sectors, Health Care (up 3.5%), Consumer Discretionary (up 2.1%), and Materials (up 1.7%) were the strongest performers today. Conversely, the Industrials sector lagged, falling 0.9%.

items.headline: Leading Economic Index for US Edges Up in July
items.summary: The Conference Board Leading Economic Index® (LEI) for the U.S. rose by 0.2% in July 2026, marking its fourth increase in six months. This suggests moderate economic growth ahead, driven partly by business investments in AI.

items.headline: U.S. Housing Starts Decline in July, Missing Forecasts
items.summary: U.S. housing starts decreased by 12.4% in July to 1.24 million units at a seasonally adjusted annual rate, falling short of market expectations. Single-family starts and multi-family starts both saw significant declines.

items.headline: Fed Minutes and Treasury Buybacks Influence Bond Market
items.summary: Minutes from the Federal Reserve's July meeting indicated that a policy tightening may be necessary if inflation does not decline. Meanwhile, the Treasury Department's decision to double buybacks of longer-dated U.S. debt to at least $4 billion per operation influenced bond yields.

items.headline: Cisco Systems Reports Strong FY26 Results, Positive AI Outlook
items.summary: Cisco Systems ($CSCO) delivered robust fourth-quarter and fiscal year 2026 results (reported August 12, 2026), exceeding guidance with strong double-digit growth. The company highlighted significant momentum in AI infrastructure orders, totaling $9.3 billion for FY26, and raised its FY27 AI infrastructure revenue guidance to $7.5 billion.
